parameters.content:
## Sandbox — syschange

**Plan, review, approve.** Nothing changes
until a plan comes back asking for approval.

```
plan  ->  202 + run_id  ->  you read it  ->  approve
```

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| `202` | planned, waiting for you |
| `200` | ran, no approval needed |
| `400` | your request was malformed |
| `502` | shim unreachable (check it) |

Header required on every call:
`X-Sandbox-Key: <caller key>`

nodes.name: Sandbox Request
nodes.notes: Auth is enforced here, not at the shim. Without a browser or script holding X-Sandbox-Key, a page on your machine cannot drive syschange.

nodes.name: Validate Request
nodes.notes: Fails fast and specifically, so a bad call never reaches syschange.

nodes.name: Approve (host shim)
nodes.notes: Applies a previously planned run. n8n has no shell - the shim runs syschange-run with a fixed argv.

nodes.name: Plan (host shim)
nodes.notes: Read-only. Runs syschange-run plan; syschange decides on its own whether approval is required.

nodes.name: Shape Plan Result
nodes.notes: Turns syschange's parsed plan into an operator-readable answer with an explicit next step.

nodes.name: Shape Shim Failure
nodes.notes: A dead shim returns a clear 502 instead of an opaque n8n error.
